label.responsibilities:
Design and build end-to-end AI/ML systems: from data collection and processing, to model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
Research, evaluate, and apply appropriate machine learning/deep learning techniques (including large language models - LLMs, computer vision, NLP, recommendation systems, etc.) to solve business problems.
Build and maintain MLOps pipelines: automate training, testing, deployment (CI/CD), monitoring, and model retraining.
Optimize performance, latency, scalability, and operating cost of AI systems in production environments.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into feasible technical solutions.
Design AI system architecture (APIs, microservices, vector databases, feature stores, etc.) ensuring security, reliability, and maintainability.
Monitor and evaluate model quality after deployment (model drift, bias, fairness) and propose continuous improvements.
Provide technical leadership: conduct code/architecture reviews, establish best practices, and coach/mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
Stay current with emerging AI trends (LLMs, GenAI, agentic AI, etc.) and recommend adoption aligned with product strategy.
Produce technical documentation, system design documents, and model operating procedures.
label.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Have 3-5 years of experience in AI/Machine Learning, including experience deploying at least 2-3 AI projects into production.
Proficient in Python and common ML frameworks/libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or Generative AI/LLM (RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering).
Solid understanding of MLOps principles: model versioning, CI/CD for ML, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), monitoring (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc.).
Experience working with large-scale data systems and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, distributed system design, and APIs (REST/gRPC).
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills.
Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical audiences.
Technical leadership ability, with effective mentoring and teamwork skills across multiple projects.
Proactive and eager to learn, staying up to date with emerging AI technology trends.
Good English reading comprehension of technical documents; spoken English is a plus.
